name: Country
definition: 具有明确地理边界与主权管辖范围的政治实体，是联赛等体育组织活动的所属地域单元 Counterexample: 与'地区/城市'混淆：地区或城市是主权国家内部的次级行政单元，不具备主权属性 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Country; provenance: direct source Country

name: League
definition: 由若干球队按既定赛制在特定赛季内进行周期性对抗比赛的体育竞赛组织，隶属于某一国家 Counterexample: 与'杯赛/锦标赛'混淆：杯赛通常为淘汰制短期赛事，而联赛为跨时段循环积分赛制 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table League; provenance: direct source League

name: Match
definition: 在特定日期于某一联赛赛季阶段中，由主队与客队两支球队之间进行的、以进球数决定胜负的体育对抗事件 Counterexample: 与'赛季/阶段'混淆：赛季或阶段是比赛的时间分组容器，本身不是对抗事件 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Match; provenance: direct source Match

name: Player
definition: 以参加足球比赛为职业或半职业活动、具备可测量身体属性并隶属于球队的自然人 Counterexample: 与'教练/裁判'混淆：教练与裁判虽参与比赛但不作为参赛球员上场竞技 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Player; provenance: direct source Player

name: Team
definition: 由多名球员组成、以参加联赛比赛为目的的体育竞技组织，具有正式名称与唯一标识 Counterexample: 与'球员'混淆：球员是自然人个体，球队是由球员组成的组织集体 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Team; provenance: direct source Team

name: Player_Attributes
definition: 在某一日期对某名球员的能力评分与身体技术指标进行采集所形成的结构化信息记录，用于描述该球员在彼时的竞技水平 Counterexample: 与'球员'混淆：球员是自然人实体，属性记录是对该实体在特定时点的量化描述信息 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Player_Attributes; provenance: direct source Player_Attributes

name: Team_Attributes
definition: 在某一日期对某支球队的战术风格与攻防能力进行采集所形成的结构化信息记录，用于描述该球队在彼时的战术特征 Counterexample: 与'球队'混淆：球队是竞技组织实体，属性记录是对该组织在特定时点的战术量化描述信息 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Team_Attributes; provenance: direct source Team_Attributes

name: BuildUpPlaySpeed
definition: Team's build-up play speed attribute value.

name: BuildUpPlayPassing
definition: Team's build-up play passing attribute value.

name: ChanceCreationPassingClass
definition: Classification of team's chance creation passing style.
aliases: played safe while creating chance of passing

name: OverallRating
definition: Player's overall rating value.

name: AttackingWorkRate
definition: Player's attacking work rate classification.

name: DefensiveWorkRate
definition: Player's defensive work rate classification.

name: Height
definition: Player's height in centimeters.

name: Volleys
definition: Player's volleys attribute value.

name: Dribbling
definition: Player's dribbling attribute value.

name: Finishing
definition: Player's finishing attribute value.

name: HomeTeamGoals
definition: Number of goals scored by the home team in a match.

name: AwayTeamGoals
definition: Number of goals scored by the away team in a match.

name: Season
definition: Season identifier for matches.

name: LeagueName
definition: Name of the league.

name: TeamLongName
definition: Full name of the team.

name: TeamShortName
definition: Short name of the team.

name: TeamFifaApiId
definition: FIFA API identifier for the team.

name: PlayerName
definition: Full name of the player.

name: Birthday
definition: Player's date of birth.

name: Date
definition: Date of the attribute record.

name: TotalGoals
definition: Total number of goals scored in a match. Formula: HomeTeamGoals + AwayTeamGoals. Inputs: HomeTeamGoals = Match.home_team_goal; AwayTeamGoals = Match.away_team_goal

name: AverageOverallRating
definition: Average of player's overall ratings over time. Formula: AVG(OverallRating). Inputs: OverallRating = Player_Attributes.overall_rating

name: PercentageDifferenceOverallRating
definition: Percentage difference between two players' overall ratings. Formula: (OverallRating1 - OverallRating2) / OverallRating2 * 100. Inputs: OverallRating = Player_Attributes.overall_rating

name: AverageBuildUpPlayPassing
definition: Average build-up play passing across all teams. Formula: AVG(BuildUpPlayPassing). Inputs: BuildUpPlayPassing = Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayPassing

name: AverageFinishing
definition: Average finishing attribute for a player. Formula: AVG(Finishing). Inputs: Finishing = Player_Attributes.finishing

name: MaxHeight
definition: Maximum height among players. Formula: MAX(Height). Inputs: Height = Player.height

name: MinHeight
definition: Minimum height among players. Formula: MIN(Height). Inputs: Height = Player.height

name: CountPlayers
definition: Count of players matching criteria. Formula: COUNT(PlayerName). Inputs: PlayerName = Player.player_name

name: TotalMatches
definition: Count of matches in a season or league. Formula: COUNT(Match.id). Inputs: Season = Match.season WHERE season = '2015/2016'; LeagueName = League.name WHERE name = 'Scotland Premier League'

name: TotalWins
definition: Count of wins for a team. Formula: COUNT(CASE WHEN HomeTeamGoals > AwayTeamGoals THEN 1 END) + COUNT(CASE WHEN AwayTeamGoals > HomeTeamGoals THEN 1 END). Inputs: HomeTeamGoals = Match.home_team_goal; AwayTeamGoals = Match.away_team_goal

name: TeamPlayingStyle
definition: Analysis of team playing style attributes such as build-up play, chance creation, and defence.

name: PlayerWorkRate
definition: Analysis of player work rates, including attacking and defensive tendencies.

name: PlayerPreferredFoot
definition: Analysis of player's preferred foot.
